runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game potc_600af --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/potc-switch-test-optos.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. The scenario uses the named S.A.M. Back and Select keys only to reach the switch test; every held address is a direct public switch write in the playfield matrix.

named_action_observations.label: public 1 (an ordinary switch) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints LEFT LANE and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active
public 3 (a printed opto) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints HIT CHEST and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active
public 4 (a printed opto) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints PLUNDER EXIT and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active

public 21 (a printed opto) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints TROUGH #1 (R) and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active

public 22 (a printed opto) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints TROUGH JAM and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active; while it is held the ROM also pulses the trough eject (solenoid 1) twice, as it does to clear a ball from the jam position

public 1 (an ordinary switch) held at 1 for 3 s again: the ROM prints LEFT LANE and marks it in the grid, and after the release it prints NONE and clears the grid, so it reads public 1 as active

raw_runs.name: potc-600af-switch-test-optos
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, and the ROM came up in attract mode with no factory-reset message to dismiss, so the scenario's only service input before the switch test is Back followed by five Select presses

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame was visually checked, and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256. Exact external directory manifest potc_600af/manifest.json SHA-256 094d6f965910856fb9456181ab91c10715717cdbf88718b96e2a65e2f511c616 (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py); it lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
